criteria.text:
Scenario: Author adds a competency
  Given the competency list
  When the author clicks Add
  Then the new competency appears

Scenario: Author changes the level
  Given a competency at level 2
  When the author picks level 3
  Then the list shows level 3

Scenario: Deleting asks for confirmation
  When the author deletes a competency
  Then a confirmation dialog appears

backgrounds.text:
Background:
  Given an author is logged in
